m: एठ् cl. 1. Ā. एठते, एठां-चक्रे, एठिता, &c., to be a rogue or rascal; to cheat, Dhātup. viii, 14.
a: एठ् — {c1c} A. (एठते, एठितुं, एठित) To annoy, resist, oppose.

s: Na bADane । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvAdiM-AtmaM sakaM-sew .) bADanaM vihatiH । Na eWate vatsaraM lokaH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: bADane BvAdi॰ Atma॰ aka॰ sew । eWate EWizwa raWAm baBUva Asa cakre । eWanam eWitaH । bADanamatra SAWyam
